intro.h2: The crew you keep calling back
paragraphs: Reel and Sons, LLC takes on home improvement in Snow Camp and nearby towns, the kind of jobs that keep an older house in shape and make a room feel new. Their logo says home improvement specialists, and the reviews show a crew that solves problems as they come up.

When a new fiberglass door did not fit one customer's frame, BJ adjusted the frame and got it installed. When a back door job turned up a flooring problem caused by the house itself, the crew found new flooring to match. Customers say they keep using Reel and Sons for work around their homes.

services.h2: Home improvement in Snow Camp, NC and nearby

items.name: Doors and frames
items.blurb: Front and back door replacement, including the frame when it needs it. BJ installed a fiberglass door that did not fit the existing frame by adjusting the frame, and another family had their back door and frame replaced in one job.

image.alt: New dark gray front door with sidelights and white trim under a covered entry

items.name: Feature walls and fireplaces
items.blurb: Shiplap accent walls built around an electric fireplace, with a wood mantel and space for the TV. One reviewer's wife helped pick out exactly how the shiplap wall would look, and the family recommends Reel and Sons for any home project.

image.alt: White distressed shiplap wall with blue-lit electric fireplace, rustic wood mantel and wall-mounted TV

items.name: Flooring installs and repairs
items.blurb: Flooring repair and installation, including fixing areas damaged by problems in the house itself. On one job the crew removed the damaged flooring and found new flooring that complemented the rest, giving the area a fresh look.

image.alt: Living room with shiplap fireplace wall and dark wood-look floor

items.name: Trim, decks and porches
items.blurb: Baseboards, window trim and crown molding ready for paint, plus decks and porch work. Recent Facebook posts show an 11 by 20 foot deck, posts and beams going in, and composite porch rails with LED post lights for a customer.

image.alt: Gray two-story house with yellow front door, brick front steps and covered porch

items.name: Land clearing and forestry mulching
items.blurb: Overgrown lots and fence lines cleared with a forestry mulcher. Reel and Sons has helped customers push back property lines they had not seen in over 10 years, and on one 2-day job mulched as much extra as time allowed.

image.alt: Before and after of an overgrown field cleared by a tracked skid steer with a forestry mulcher

why_choose_us.h2: Why homeowners keep calling Reel and Sons

items.title: Problems get solved
items.text: A door that did not fit the frame, flooring damaged by an issue in the house: reviewers describe the crew working through surprises instead of leaving them for you.

items.title: Personable and reliable
items.text: "I highly recommend this company. Personable and reliable," one homeowner wrote, adding that the crew was timely and efficient and cleaned up after the job.

items.title: Good advice, even off the clock
items.text: Plumbing advice is a recurring theme in the reviews. Google's summary quotes a customer saying Bruce gave very good advice on a plumbing problem.

items.title: You help decide the look
items.text: On a shiplap fireplace wall, the crew let the homeowner's wife help choose exactly how the wall would look. Your taste leads, they build it.

about.text: Reel and Sons, LLC is a home improvement company at 2255 Quakenbush Rd in Snow Camp, North Carolina, calling itself home improvement specialists. Customers know BJ for doors, porch rails and a shiplap fireplace wall, and mention Bruce for his plumbing advice. The crew works across the area, with Facebook posts from jobs in Graham and Durham, and its work ranges from trim and baseboards to decks and land clearing. One customer with a 20 year old house says she finally has a company she can trust for ongoing upkeep.

image.alt: Reel and Sons logo: yellow saw blade behind the words Reel and Sons, Home Improvement Specialists

process.h2: How a project with Reel and Sons works

steps.title: Call or email
steps.text: Call (919) 578-3330, Monday to Saturday 8 AM to 5 PM, or email with photos of the job.

steps.title: Estimate
steps.text: Reel and Sons has offered free estimates on its Facebook page. Ask when you call and set a time for a visit.

steps.title: Choose the look
steps.text: Pick materials and finishes with the crew. Customers have chosen their own shiplap layout and matching flooring.

steps.title: The work and the surprises
steps.text: The crew does the job and works through problems that come up, like frames that need adjusting or hidden flooring damage.

steps.title: Clean up
steps.text: The site is cleaned up when the job is done. Reviewers mention a timely, efficient crew that left things tidy.

items.name: Cherelle J.
items.text: I highly recommend this company. Personable and reliable. They replaced our back door, the frame and ended up having to remove some flooring due to an issue from the house itself. New complimentary flooring was found and gave us a new look in the area. They were timely, efficient and cleaned up after the job. Great value for the price. With having to do more up keep on our 20 year old house I am excited that I now have a company I can trust. Now I look forward to the up coming projects.

items.name: Jeff G.
items.text: BJ did such an awesome job on the wall we wanted to do in our home for an electric fireplace. Very professional and let my wife help pick out the way the wall was to be with shiplap. I highly recommend them for any home project.

items.name: Michael T.
items.text: BJ came by to install a fiberglass door.  The door did not fit my frame which is something I was never aware could happen.  He managed to get it installed by making adjustments to the frame.  He, also, install composite rails for my porch as well as led posts to provide light at night.  Great work, and I continue to use for work around my home.

service_area.h2: Serving Snow Camp, Graham and Durham
service_area.text: Reel and Sons, LLC is based at 2255 Quakenbush Rd in Snow Camp, North Carolina. Its Facebook posts show jobs in Graham and Durham, and a land clearing customer in Winston. If you are in or around Snow Camp and need a door, floor, trim, deck or feature wall project done, call (919) 578-3330 to check that your home is in range.

items.q: What kind of projects do you take on?
items.a: Doors and frames, flooring installs and repairs, shiplap and fireplace feature walls, baseboards, window trim and crown molding, decks, porch rails with LED post lights, and land clearing with a forestry mulcher. If your job is not on the list, call and describe it.

Reel and Sons has invited customers on Facebook to call for a free estimate at (919) 578-3330. Call to confirm how estimates work for your project and to set up a visit. You can also email photos to reelandsonsllc@gmail.com first so the crew can see the job.

items.q: What if my door does not fit the frame?
items.a: That happened to one customer, who had never known it was possible. BJ made adjustments to the frame and got the new fiberglass door installed. Another family had their back door and its frame replaced together. Mention the age and condition of your door when you call.

Monday through Saturday from 8 AM to 5 PM, closed on Sunday. Call (919) 578-3330 or email reelandsonsllc@gmail.com with a short description and photos of what you need done, and the crew will get back to you about scheduling a visit.

items.q: Can you help with an older house?
items.a: Yes. One customer with a 20 year old house had a back door, frame and some flooring replaced after an issue from the house itself, and says she is excited to have a company she can trust for upcoming upkeep projects.

final_cta.h2: Got a project on your list?
final_cta.text: Call Reel and Sons and talk it through.
